{{Short description|Taiwan-born American theoretical particle physicist (born 1930)}}
{{BLP one source|date=July 2025}}
'''Yung-su Tsai''' (born 1 February 1930 in [[Yuli, Hualien]]<ref name=Tsai>{{cite web|url=http://www.slac.stanford.edu/cgi-wrap/getdoc/slac-pub-7437.pdf|title=My Recollections as a Physicist|author=Yung su Tsai|access-date=2019-04-03|date=28 December 1996}}</ref>) is a Taiwanese-born American theoretical particle physicist who was a professor at [[Stanford University]] and was noted for his work at the [[SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory]] and specifically the discovery of the [[tau (particle)|tau]] [[lepton]].<ref name=Tsai/>
